name: B2 practice without a set exam
reading: A B2-level text against the clock with comprehension items and a key (matching, true or false, multiple choice), a different text type each time.
listening: B2-level recorded speech with comprehension items and a key, a different kind each week: news, an interview, announcements.

writing.name: an opinion post
writing.task: A post of about 150 words that gives and justifies an opinion, with an example.

writing.name: a formal email
writing.task: A formal email of about 100 words, a request or a complaint, with a subject line, a greeting, an introduction and a close.

writing_rule: Check the content first (every point the task asks for), then coherence, range and accuracy.
speaking: a short prepared talk on a familiar topic, then questions about it
a discussion: give and justify a view, then react to the other side
